build:solidx.summary: solidx module: 16 construction commands (5 plane modes, 5 axis and 6 point types as caxis/cpoint features), Offset/Replace/Split/Remove Faces, Remove Features, Align, Base Feature environment, Edit Face, local Automated Modeling. Face healing uses an own cell decomposition (no defeaturing in the wasm).
sharedEdits: src/model.js: FIELDS.cplane distance:'none'; axisFromRef resolves caxis; CPLANE_MODES registry + registerCPlaneMode; scaleCenter resolves cpoint
src/modules/dialogs/cmd-split-scale.js: Scale point accepts construction points
build:solidx.contracts: Refs {kind:'caxis', id}, {kind:'cpoint', id}; st.axes, st.points; M.registerCPlaneMode(mode, fn); feature types caxis, cpoint, offsetface, replaceface, splitface, removefaces, removefeatures, align, basefeature, editface, automodel; environment 'basefeature' with BaseFeatureStop. Details in src/modules/solidx/README.md.
